concerns.text: Task T010 (Create data schema contracts) is marked [X] (completed) but the file path `specs/001-lm-axive-noise-injection/contracts/` contains a typo ('lm-axive' vs 'llmxive') and the task description implies the artifacts do not exist yet. The spec requires these contracts (dataset.schema.yaml, etc.) for data hygiene (Constitution III). No task exists to actually generate these schema files if they are missing, creating a gap for FR-006/FR-009 validation logic which relies on them.

Tasks T015, T016, T017 (Baseline extraction loop, validation, logging) are marked [ ] (pending) but the Analyze Report flags them as 'REJECTED' due to missing artifacts. There is no task to resolve the 'REJECTED' status or re-implement the missing logic. Without a task to fix T015-T017, User Story 1 cannot be completed, violating FR-002 (extract hidden states) and FR-004 (calculate similarity).

Task T021 (Input Drift Check) and T026 (Sweep Logging) are marked [X] (completed) but the Analyze Report flags them as 'REJECTED' due to missing implementations. No task exists to address these failures. This leaves FR-009 (semantic drift metric) and FR-011 (validity pass-rate logging) unimplemented, breaking the core experimental loop.

Task T031 (Analysis orchestration) is marked [ ] (pending). However, T030 (Analysis logic) includes sub-tasks for 'validity collapse point' and 'trade-off curve' which are also required by FR-003 and FR-007. T033 duplicates the trade-off curve logic. There is no clear task to integrate the 'validity collapse point' distribution (SC-006) into the final report if T031 is the only orchestration task.

Task T010 path typo: `specs/001-lm-axive-noise-injection/contracts/` should be `specs/001-llmxive-noise-injection/contracts/` (or match the actual branch name `001-lm-axive-noise-injection` if that is the canonical branch, but the spec file uses `001-llmxive-follow-up...`). The inconsistency between the task path and the spec/plan paths creates ambiguity.

Task T033 'Generate a trade-off curve report' duplicates the scope of T030 which explicitly states 'Explicitly generates the trade-off curve... if no valid sigma exists'. This creates confusion on whether T033 is a separate task or a redundant step. T033 should be removed or merged into T030 to avoid scope ambiguity.
